correctness.rationale: Confirmed the nonstandard ninth-moment polynomial certificate exactly: rational integral of lower alternating J1 polynomial on [0,7/2] is 0.013703182867... >137/10000. Independent outward fixed-point interval sixth-power Simpson calculation on 6001 rational nodes and Watson tail bound gives I1(6)<0.108884052<109/1000. Also recomputed exact rational bounded-order k=2..11 sixth moment integration cores below 0.07; published Xu fifth-moment 13/40 plus Landau sup amplitude supplies k>=12 analytically, and a Sonin monotonicity argument handles k=2 sup<1/2. Hölder implies I1(q)>0.0137*2^(-(q-9)) while Ik(q)<0.1*2^(-(q-6)) for all real finite q>=9, with strict gap since 0.0137>0.0125. The sharp stability coefficient and equality modes follow from Xu radial-angular spectral theorem. Infinite range does not follow from finite numerics alone.
